caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair rendered in naturalistic detail. The chair is composed of light to medium brown wood, with visible grain patterns and shading that indicate texture and wear. It has a solid, flat seat with a slightly scooped surface, a curved backrest that extends to form short armrests, and five vertical spindles connecting the seat to the backrest. The chair's legs are slightly splayed outward for stability, with four legs joined by two sets of horizontal stretchers – one set connecting the front and back legs, and another set connecting the side legs. The illustration is positioned centrally against an off-white background with no additional objects or details. The artist’s name, "HARRY M. WADDELL," is printed in small, uppercase black lettering near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Armchair
